about: The weeks that go wrong, from the week after the backup to a 13-episode finale: a tribe swap at Episode 7 with a quit (out with no vote) as well as a vote; a night nobody goes home at 8 (no Tribal); a week off the air before 9 (research says the next episode is two weeks on, and the app's schedule takes it from there); the merge at 9, then a player flags the night's immunity win as wrong and the desk decides it didn't happen (out of every game); a double boot at 10 with an idol played at the first vote, then the desk corrects how the first one left (Voted Out to Medically Evacuated); at 11 one game is given a result of its own the season hasn't (a reward, as a commissioner once entered one) and the desk's Make every game match takes it out; another double boot at 12; the finale as usual. The Drive-By changes a move at Episode 9's lock (five minutes either side).
